summary: Frontend-only retest of the deep-dive reader INTRO/first-screen bug set (overlap of icon+text in the 3-badge info grid, oversized cover title, cut-off INTRODUCTION, missing container around the badges). Tested 6 stories (v5-samoa-giorno, v5-lez-correnti-clima, sky-blue-sunset-orange, v9-why-do-we-eat-three-meals-a-day-it-wasn-t-always-like-th, why-we-sleep [Corpo umano], v4-lez-abitudini [Psicologia]) on 360x720, 390x844 and the extreme 320x640 viewport. All FIVE required intro elements (deep-dive-cover-title, story-info-grid, reader-intro-eyebrow, deep-dive-hook, deep-dive-scroll-hint) fit fully inside the first screen (top>=0 AND bottom<=viewportH) on every viewport for every story, with scrollTop==0. The 3-badge info grid never overlaps between cells (kind/category/time) and never overlaps icon-vs-value inside any cell; no horizontal clipping (scrollWidth<=clientWidth+1 for every value). The grid has a visible glass container (backgroundColor rgba(8,11,21,0.58), borderWidth 1px, rounded 16px) as requested. Cover-title computed font-size is between 18px and 24px in every case (samoa=20, correnti=18, sky-blue=20, three-meals=20, why-we-sleep=22, abitudini=18). Wheel navigation on sky-blue-sunset-orange @390x844: one tick down moves scrollTop 0->788 (offsetTop(chapter-1)=844, expected=844-56=788, delta=0); one tick up returns to 0 exactly. No React errors in console beyond the known RN-Web deprecation warnings from prior iterations (textShadow*, props.pointerEvents, Reanimated easing).

issues: On the very long category 'GEOGRAFIA & VIAGGI' the category-value wraps to 3 logical lines but is capped by numberOfLines=2 (scrollHeight=45 vs clientHeight=30 -> visible ellipsis 'GEOGRAP HY & ...'). Horizontal fit is OK (sw==cw) and cells still do not overlap; per the review-request note this is a legitimate overflow on 320x640 and reported for information only. On 360x720 and 390x844 the same combo renders 'GEOGRAPHY & TRAVEL' fully on 2 lines without ellipsis.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present (unchanged from iter1/iter2): '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/category-grid.tsx:149,153 and /app/frontend/src/components/reader-intro.tsx:157 (coverTitle textShadowColor/Offset/Radius).

Console warning still present (unchanged): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (RN-Web). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/reader-section.tsx:48,110 and /app/frontend/src/components/story-info-grid.tsx:48 (LinearGradient divider uses pointerEvents prop).
Console warning still present (unchanged): '[Reanimated] Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/category-grid.tsx:41.

action_items: No fix needed for the reported bugs: overlap, title size, intro cut-off and missing badge container are all resolved on 360x720 and 390x844 for all 6 sampled stories.

Optional (not blocking, extreme viewport): if 320x640 must render 'GEOGRAFIA & VIAGGI' without ellipsis, either drop numberOfLines to 3 for that cell, shorten the label, or slightly reduce the value font-size when winW<=320.

Optional carry-over from iter1/iter2: migrate textShadow* -> textShadow style shorthand (reader-intro.tsx:157 coverTitle + category-grid.tsx), move LinearGradient/pointerEvents prop into style, and switch category-grid FadeInUp easing to a web-supported curve.
critical_code_review_comments: story-info-grid.tsx: layout is now robust — cellFixed for kind/time and cellGrow (flex:1, minWidth:0) for category, plus numberOfLines={2} on values, prevents icon+text overlap across all sampled categories/kinds; container 'gridInline' (borderRadius 16, border 1px, translucent surfaceDeep bg, inset boxShadow) matches the requested enclosure.

reader-intro.tsx: CoverTitle font-size ladder 24/22/20/18 based on title length is confirmed at runtime (18 for very long titles like correnti-clima/why-do-we-eat/abitudini) — matches the '~30% reduction' request.

reader-intro.tsx: onFit callback measures column+hint heights and clamps cover height so the whole intro (title, badges, INTRODUCTION eyebrow, hook and scroll hint) fits the first screen. Verified on 320/360/390 that all 5 testIDs are within [0, viewportH].
deep-dive/[id].tsx: wheel step and jumpTo(1) still land exactly on offsetTop(chapter-1)-56 (388->788 on 390x844) with delta=0 and one tick up returns to scrollTop 0.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 stories pass full intro/first-screen checks on 360x720 and 390x844; 6/6 also pass all horizontal/overlap/font-size/container checks on 320x640 with only a vertical numberOfLines=2 ellipsis on 'GEOGRAFIA & VIAGGI' (expected per the review-request note).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The intro-fit contract (onFit -> readerCoverFrame reserveCap, min cover 200px) is stable on the web preview. When re-running these tests remember to force scrollTop=0 on [data-testid='deep-dive-scroll'] right after page load (reading progress can auto-scroll if a previous run left a saved section). The reader header counter is not rendered on the intro (section 0), so any check that reads [data-testid='reader-header-counter'] should be executed AFTER at least one wheel tick down (mid-state), not on the intro. Home->reader morph transition end-to-end (open onboarding, complete quickly, tap first card) was NOT re-tested in this iteration to focus on the intro bug report; it was already covered end-to-end in previous iterations and the reader entry code path (morph=1 + rect) is unchanged.
rca_of_issue: Original user reports (icon/text overlap on CURIOSITY + GEOGRAFIA & VIAGGI, oversized title, INTRODUCTION cut-off, missing badge container) are all resolved by the current code: (a) story-info-grid switches kind/time cells to shrink-to-content (cellFixed) and gives category the remaining space with numberOfLines={2} (never overlaps horizontally, wraps vertically to 2 lines); (b) CoverTitle uses a 24/22/20/18 ladder driven by title length -> matches the requested ~30% reduction; (c) ReaderIntro reports column+hint heights via onFit so readerCoverFrame clamps cover height and the whole intro (title, badges, INTRODUCTION eyebrow, hook, scroll hint) lands inside the first screen; (d) story-info-grid.gridInline now provides an actual glass container (translucent surfaceDeep bg + 1px brand border + inset boxShadow + rounded 16px) instead of just dividers. Verified numerically on 6 stories x 3 viewports.
